THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 7
Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4-3/6/2015/HW/34.
My Reference No.: 2/1/15/67.
I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 ofthe Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends toacquire the following lands which are required for a publicpurpose.
Description of the land to be acquired:

Lot No. 982 to 1061 (Lots 77) allotments in total extent ofabout 0.4881 Hectare, of land in Final Village Plan No. 127,Supplement No. 22, Sheet No. 23 and dated 01-06-2017,prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Surveys, Kalutharaon behalf of the Surveyor General situated in the villageof Bellana in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 834B,Kapugama and Divisional Secretary's Division ofPalindanuwara in Kaluthara District in Western Province.
